subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Setup Engine select a prerelease as the default before a published OpenClaw artifact contains the wizard-runtime fix and demonstrates successful native Windows setup?
rationale: This is a release-policy choice with a known first-run failure mode; neither a mechanical repair nor CI can turn an unshipped upstream dependency into a supported default artifact.

options.title: Keep a setup-proven default
options.body: Retain the current supported default and keep beta selection explicit until an official artifact contains the core fix and has exact-artifact proof.

options.title: Accept prerelease-default risk
options.body: Promote beta.2 now while explicitly accepting that fresh native-wizard setup is known to fail until the upstream release lands.

recommendation.title: Keep a setup-proven default
recommendation.body: Retain the current supported default and keep beta selection explicit until an official artifact contains the core fix and has exact-artifact proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied implementation history ties CassieMei to the proposed artifact-selection and setup-lifecycle path, making them the best available routing candidate for the release-policy discussion.
